trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — the big silver grind of the activities. Stunts are a repeatable free-roam activity, so this is a route problem, not a skill wall: learn where the stunt jumps cluster, run them in circuits on a fast, durable vehicle, and let the counter on this card pace you (a few circuits a session beats one miserable marathon). Failed attempts cost nothing but time, so keep moving rather than perfecting any single jump.
